opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to paid Bitcoin-mining pools, with options visibly priced at $500, $1,000, and $2,000 and accompanied by Buy Now buttons. It describes a pool share as providing “one share of the entire pool of the bitcoin that's been mined” and promises that participants are “getting payouts every day from the mining of Bitcoin.” Continued participation is also conditioned on repurchases to obtain newer equipment. The compensation structure extends beyond mining: viewers are rewarded for sharing the network, placing recruits into left and right teams, earning 5 percent of purchases by sponsored participants, and being paid repeatedly on every person in their downline. Together, these features emphasize earnings through paid participation, recruitment, purchases, and repeated downline activity.
